note: For a person, grand most naturally means tall; English 'big' is misleading for learners.
sortir de là means get out of there; 'help me out here' is a different English idiom.
proposed_english: Help me get out of there!

note: C'est mon bagage means 'This is my luggage', not 'Here is my baggage'.
Mon vélo est ici is a location statement, not a presenting 'Here is...'.
là means there; English incorrectly says 'Here is'.
French explicitly says 'back at the same point'; English drops that content.
proposed_target: Nous voici donc de nouveau au même point.
proposed_english: Here we are back at the same point again.

note: être reconnaissant means be grateful, not merely appreciate.
proposed_target: Je te suis reconnaissant pour ton temps.
proposed_english: I am grateful to you for your time.
